details: services/capital/risk_policy.py RiskPolicyEvaluator.evaluate enforces max_sector_exposure -> sector_exposures, turnover_limit -> turnover, and liquidity_constraints -> liquidity (avg_daily_volume and order_pct_adv) without introducing a second rule engine.

On runtime_action='order_increase', missing facts fail closed with 'Risk policy limit <limit> cannot be evaluated: <fact> unavailable' (codes: sector_exposures_unavailable, turnover_unavailable, liquidity_unavailable).

On runtime_action='order_reduce' (and pure reducing exits in EvaluateOrderRiskGate / close_leg in expression_policy.py), reduce-only orders are always allowed even when facts are absent or current exposures exceed policy limits.

services/persona/risk_policy_draft.py requires max_sector_exposure, turnover_limit, and liquidity_constraints to be stated in the draft JSON (either valid ratios/constraints or explicit null / {'none': true, 'reason': '...'} with a non-empty omission reason stored in metadata.risk_officer_draft.omitted_limits).

services/capital/risk_policy.py validate_drafted_pool_risk_policy and profile_outer_bounds support configured outer bounds for max_sector_exposure, turnover_limit, max_order_pct_adv, min_avg_daily_volume, and liquidity_constraints while keeping DEFAULT_PROFILE_OUTER_BOUNDS unchanged (only the 4 operator-decided low bounds per SD §6 Q2; no invented numbers).
Existing policies without these three limits continue trading unchanged (missing limit = not applied).

- Sector over cap with partial room: 2303.TW holds 19,000 TWD in Taiwan industry sector '24' against 25% cap (~25,000 TWD); new buy of 45 shares of 2330.TW @ 200 TWD is reduced to 29 shares (5,800 TWD) with resize_reason='max_sector_exposure' and binding_limit='max_sector_exposure'.
- Sector over cap with 0 room: subsequent buy of 10 shares of 2330.TW is refused with reason='max_sector_exposure'.
- Illiquid order (> 5% of 20-day ADV from tw_price_daily): 600 shares of 2317.TW against 10,000 ADV (6% > 5%) is refused with reason='liquidity_order_pct_adv_breach'.
- Turnover breach: 105 shares of 2317.TW @ 200 TWD (21,000 TWD) after 24,800 TWD prior window fills (45,800 / ~100,000 > 0.45 turnover_limit) is refused with reason='turnover_limit'.

- Missing fact on increase: buy on unclassified 9999.TW is refused with reason='sector_exposures_unavailable' and diagnostic='Risk policy limit max_sector_exposure cannot be evaluated: sector_exposures unavailable'.
- Reduce-only order: selling 29 held shares of 2330.TW with close_leg=True passes and fills 29 shares even with sector at cap and facts marked unavailable.
